features.title: Top Features of Our Platform for Crop Monitoring

list.title: Remote Satellite Field Condition Monitoring
list.description: Monitor vegetation condition in different zones without going to the field. Use 10 ready-made vegetation indices to make informed decisions. Thanks to regular and high-precision Sentinel-2 and PlanetScope images without clouds and shadows, you can track crops in real time with a resolution of up to 3 m, which allows you to quickly respond to any threats.

list.title: Growth Phases
list.description: Plan field work according to crop development stages in the Growth Stages chart in the remote crop monitoring app. The Growth Stages chart is available for all crops based on the BBCH scale and sowing date.

list.title: Risk Map
list.description: Monitor risks of diseases, weather changes, and vegetation index fluctuations across all your fields. Identify threats at early stages, prevent disease outbreaks, and protect your harvest from losses.

list.title: Variable Rate Application Maps
list.description: Increase the profitability of each hectare and save on fertilizers, pesticides, seeds, and water using variable rate application (VRA) maps. Use various data sources to create VRA maps: NDVI, NDMI, RECI, MSAVI, terrain data, or information from agricultural practices. Minimize losses and optimize resources!

list.title: Work Log
list.description: Monitor crop conditions remotely and control the impact of agricultural practices on land productivity. All team members have access to previous and current field operations, including soil tillage, irrigation, agro-scouting, and much more. With our precision farming platform, it's easy to plan and assign new tasks for specific plots and monitor their execution.

list.title: Yield Assessment
list.description: Make informed decisions by forecasting yield and biomass 14 days ahead. The feature analyzes key parameters such as crop type, irrigation methods, and weather data to provide valuable insights for farm management.

list.title: Weather Analysis
list.description: Get accurate 14-day forecasts, analyze historical weather data, and monitor temperature stress to protect fields from extreme conditions. Plan optimal times for spraying and soil treatment based on accurate weather data. Connect ground weather stations for even greater accuracy.

list.title: Automatic Reports
list.description: Receive automatic reports on crop conditions for all your fields. View overall statistics on field operations and crops. Configure important parameters in reports and receive updates automatically.

list.title: Team Management
list.description: Distribute data access based on team members' roles. Quickly share information about vegetation conditions, field updates, and reports with colleagues.
